own_solution.law: Equilibrium of the hanging bucket: T_A = m_A g
assumptions: bucket at rest and not accelerating (stated)

notes: Authors' T_A = m_A g matches my pass-1 solution; kg * m/s^2 = N. Parameters (3.0 kg, 9.8 m/s^2) match the text and 3.0*9.8 = 29.4 N exactly, so the certified answer is correct. F_B acts on crate B on another bench that the text says never interacts with rope A or the bucket, so it is disconnected in all four renderings, which differ only in F_B. No disagreement with pass 1.
